content:
The **FEV Production Facility** is an unmarked location within the West Tek Research Center in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

The FEV Production Facility is a separate interior accessed via an elevator within the West Tek research wing, just past the doors that require the West Tek research wing access code. It was added in the *Steel Reign* update.

The Catalyst: The FEV Production Facility is the site of the final confrontation between the Brotherhood First Expeditionary Force and Dr. Edgar Blackburn, as well as his research assistants.

The FEV Production Facility appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Steel Reign* update.
